label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) is a true positive. The sink is response.sendRedirect(param) at line 22. The resolved sink value is param, which originates from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') at line 19. Although there is a conditional check on the Referer header (lines 20-21), this does not sanitize or validate the contents of param. User-controlled input is passed directly to the redirect destination, creating an open redirect/path injection vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input param flows directly to sendRedirect sink without proper validation; Referer check does not mitigate sink risk.
